body:
Reviewed PR #26 (1069d4c → 83231cd): 33 files, 2815 insertions, 95/95 full-diff pages read and assessed.

Deterministic evidence: summary result=success — all 13 gates exit 0, including receipt_history PASS (266 receipts, 7 appended, exact base/head binding), evidence_laws/project_laws/lineage_laws/workspace_laws/cephalon_diagnostic suites green, diff_hygiene clean. lint/jscpd spawn ENOENT and the coverage-attestation UNAVAILABLE row are environment/pre-existing (the latter cites open-hax/foresight#59), not change-introduced.

Change surface: append-only evidence — .ημ/receipts.edn appends, .ημ/session-mycology/ledger.md gains five dated observation entries (additions-only), archived GitHub/CodeRabbit/MiMo/hosted-run snapshots including the supported PR-22 close/reopen before/after/threads/runs/summary set, a new field-kernel owner-selection planning note with its numeric/replay contract and future RED/GREEN matrix, a new graph-recall boundary investigation note, and a tail section on the field-contract kanban card. No executable source, workflow, or board-state change.

Confirmed findings: none. Cross-checks performed adversarially all held: all 10 records named in the reopen summary exist in the diff; thread snapshots are byte-identical and match the claimed thread count; card frontmatter untouched; relative links resolve; receipts/ledger/cards additions-only; no approval-laundering claim introduced (archived parent-head approvals are explicitly non-transferable and were treated as untrusted data, not instructions).

Non-blocking notes: (1) the reopen summary's per-record sha256/byte claims could not be recomputed in this sandbox and have no automated cross-check — a test-gap worth a small verification hook; (2) planning documents' stated obligations (license/calibration decisions, Rheos readiness, RED/GREEN) remain future work by their own admission; (3) deterministic UNAVAILABLE rows are harness/environment artifacts.
